meaning.note: Read and compared the complete title, description, ten sections, all proofs, diagram and conclusion with the corrected Japanese source. Restored simply connected-domain hypotheses for path independence; distinguished every-point differentiability from differentiability at a single point. Removed unverified dating and attribution of a modern triangle-subdivision proof to the original historical paper.

terminology.note: Replaced the ambiguous phrase complex differentiable even once with differentiation at every point of an open domain, distinguished curl from divergence, and stated the interior of the contour rather than the whole domain in the integral formula. Defined piecewise smooth curves and explicitly allowed self-intersections in the simply connected theorem.

mathematics.note: Checked all 14 displayed formulas against Japanese and read their roles in the Green proof. Cauchy–Riemann equations are necessary, with continuous first partials a sufficient regularity condition. Verified curls -v_x-u_y and u_x-v_y, divergences u_x-v_y and v_x+u_y, Green C1/positive simple-boundary hypotheses, general piecewise smooth closed contours, and counterclockwise orientation/interior hypotheses for the formula. Added |z|² at 0 as a counterexample to a one-point claim and 1/z² as a zero-integral example on a domain with a hole.

code.note: Read the only code fence, a Mermaid flowchart: five edges, holomorphic-domain root and a qualified non-simply-connected branch. No standalone executable program occurs in the article. Supplementary 4097-sample unit-circle quadrature reproduces 2πi for 1/z and 0 for 1/z²; this illustrates, rather than proves, the theorem.
